name: Jürgen Steimle
bio:
Jürgen Steimle is a full professor at the Department of Computer Science and at the DFG-Cluster Of Excellence “Multimodal Computing and Interaction” at Saarland University.

More about Jürgen: https://hci.cs.uni-saarland.de/people/juergen-steimle/
